content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Ri Bhoi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.riibhoi.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMHO Ri Bhoi Staff Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DMHO Ri Bhoi Staff Nurse recruitment is 21st September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Staff Nurse position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Staff Nurse position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month. This is a contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the Staff Nurse role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) Nursing or B.Sc Nursing degree from a recognized institution and be registered with the Meghalaya Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Staff Nurse vacancy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for Staff Nurses?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies announced for the Staff Nurse position by the District Medical & Health Office Ri Bhoi.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Walk-In Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-In Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-In Interview for the Staff Nurse positions is scheduled to be held on 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for DMHO Ri Bhoi?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Medical & Health Office Ri Bhoi is www.riibhoi.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Staff Nurse recruitment is DMHO/RBD/Appt/Contractual/259/2026/3601.
